effect_7002.Desc: You're terrified of spiders of any size!
effect_7002.Name: Phobia: Spiders

effect_7003.Desc: You're terrified of cakes and similar baked goods!
effect_7003.Name: Phobia: Cakes

effect_7004.Desc: You're terrified of goblins, as well as anything associated with goblins!
effect_7004.Name: Phobia: Goblins

effect_7005.Desc: You're terrified of dogs, wolves, and other canines!
effect_7005.Name: Phobia: Dogs

effect_7006.Desc: You're terrified of snakes and other reptiles!
effect_7006.Name: Phobia: Reptiles

effect_7007.Desc: You're afraid of members of the opposite sex!
effect_7007.Name: Phobia: Opposite Sex

effect_7010.Desc: You're afraid of trees and other large vegetation!
effect_7010.Name: Phobia: Trees

effect_7011.Desc: You've become convinced that invisible demons are tracking you and obstructing your every effort.
effect_7011.Name: Delusion: Invisible Demons

effect_7012.Desc: You believe that everything around you is made of candy, cake, or other sugary treats!
effect_7012.Name: Delusion: Candy Lands

effect_7013.Desc: You just realized that you're in the presence of nobility. In fact, EVERYONE around you is a King (or Queen) except you!
effect_7013.Name: Delusion: All Kings

effect_7015.Desc: You believe you've become entirely invisible, except to demons. Anyone who can see you must be a demon in disguise.
effect_7015.Name: Delusion: Invisibility

effect_7016.Desc: You believe you're at a vast, world-encompassing dance party! Why isn't everyone else dancing? They're being so rude to your host!
effect_7016.Name: Delusion: Dance Party

effect_7017.Desc: You just remembered that you are a dragon in disguise, sent to assassinate a certain target!
effect_7017.Name: Delusion: Dragon Assassin

effect_7018.Desc: You seem to have an extra arm! How convenient!
effect_7018.Name: Delusion: Third Arm

effect_7019.Desc: Oh no, your face fell off! You're hideous now!
effect_7019.Name: Delusion: Face Fell Off

effect_7020.Desc: You think everyone around you is speaking in a code language you can barely understand. What are they trying to hide?
effect_7020.Name: Delusion: Secret Codes

effect_7021.Desc: You find that you can only speak in rhyme! (Whew, good thing slant rhymes are okay!)
effect_7021.Name: Dementia: Rhymes

effect_7022.Desc: You find that you can only speak in riddles!
effect_7022.Name: Dementia: Riddles

effect_7023.Desc: Everything is hilarious! You can't stop laughing!
effect_7023.Name: Manic Laughter

effect_7024.Desc: You can't speak! You can only pantomime!
effect_7024.Name: Dementia: Mute

effect_7025.Desc: When you say a pronoun (like 'him' or 'her' or 'me' or 'them') it comes out as a gibberish word!
effect_7025.Name: Dementia: Pronoun Trouble

effect_7026.Desc: You can no longer understand the concept of the number three! Even the word has no meaning to you!
effect_7026.Name: Dementia: No Number Three

effect_7027.Desc: You now perceive all males as females, and vice versa!
effect_7027.Name: Dementia: Gender-Swap

effect_7028.Desc: You keep saying molly-coddle all the time! What does that even mean?
effect_7028.Name: Dementia: Molly-Coddle

effect_7029.Desc: You feel compelled to count everything you see. Out loud!
effect_7029.Name: Dementia: Counting

effect_7030.Desc: You can't walk; you can only hop!
